# PixelScope User Guide - machine-readable entry point

Canonical source root (repository): docs/user-guide/
Generated site root: index.html
All routes below are relative to the generated site root and resolve from site/llms.txt.

Start:
- index.html
- getting-started/quick-start.html
- getting-started/concepts.html

Task workflows:
- workflows/open-images.html
- workflows/open-folders.html
- workflows/compare-images.html
- workflows/compare-many-images.html
- workflows/curate-selection.html
- workflows/compare-folder-positions.html
- workflows/inspect-roi.html
- workflows/inspect-histogram.html
- workflows/inspect-line-profile.html
- workflows/use-difference.html
- workflows/export-analysis.html
- workflows/save-and-restore-work.html
- workflows/use-remote-iqa.html

Format semantics:
- formats/standard-images.html
- formats/raw.html
- formats/yuv.html

Canonical reference:
- reference/keyboard-shortcuts.html
- reference/supported-formats.html
- reference/settings.html
- reference/terminology.html
- troubleshooting/index.html

Question routing:
- How do I compare two folders? -> workflows/compare-folder-positions.html
- How do I select an exact ROI? -> workflows/inspect-roi.html
- How do I compare more than six images? -> workflows/compare-many-images.html
- How do I reduce a large selection? -> workflows/curate-selection.html
- How does PageUp/PageDown work? -> workflows/compare-folder-positions.html
- How do I open RAW14? -> formats/raw.html
- What does stride mean? -> formats/raw.html and troubleshooting/index.html
- Why is Difference unavailable? -> workflows/use-difference.html and troubleshooting/index.html
- How do I reset a line profile? -> workflows/inspect-line-profile.html
- What is Primary? -> getting-started/concepts.html and reference/terminology.html
- How do I export Histogram or Difference? -> workflows/export-analysis.html
- How do I submit or inspect Remote IQA? -> workflows/use-remote-iqa.html

Repository-aware agents can map each generated .html route to the matching Markdown source under docs/user-guide/ when source inspection is needed.
Do not infer planned/deferred behavior from developer roadmap documents when answering end-user questions. Prefer current User Guide pages, then current product contracts/code when verification is required.
